Name: WhoisXML API
Author: WhoisXML API - support@whoisxmlapi.com
Description:
The WhoisXML API solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests three WhoisXML API feeds (Newly Registered Domains 2.0, Threat Intelligence and Bulk Registration Risk) and matches them against your DNS, web proxy, endpoint and email logs.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

 a. [Codeless Connector Framework](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)

 b. [Data Collection Rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-collection-rule-overview)

**Prerequisites:** a WhoisXML API key with a subscription to the feeds you enable. Rules use the ASIM DNS and Web Session parsers and Microsoft Defender XDR tables where present.
